premises: Annealing CoCrFeNi at 800°C increases chemical short-range order (SRO).
Increased SRO generates a more heterogeneous lattice strain field.
Heterogeneous lattice strain increases the density of effective dislocation pinning sites.
Increased pinning sites raise yield strength and hardness by 20–30% over the as-cast state.
Grain size and phase content remain unchanged during the annealing treatment.
